trail.name: Phelps Lake from Death Canyon
trail.coordinateNote: Official NPS Death Canyon Trailhead marker; 2.0 m from reviewed route/access geometry. This is an area forecast reference, not navigation or uniform conditions along the route.
trail.planningNote: Access restriction reviewed September 5, 2026: NPS reports the old Death Canyon road and trailhead closed, including to pedestrians. These published distances use that old start; do not use them for an alternate trailhead or the future relocated start. Check NPS construction updates before planning.

additionalSources.note: Official NPS activity-map configuration used to identify the named route corridor; alternate access routes and branches are not silently substituted.
NPS reports the old trailhead closed to all traffic and says relocation will lengthen hikes. Saved route statistics must be re-reviewed for the new start; alternative access has different distances.

comparison.note: Reviewed NPS-origin USGS segments, with clipped sections and return legs counted explicitly, total 3.684 mi (-0.4% versus NPS). This is route-corridor evidence, not a navigation track.

photo.alt: A lake sits at the base of a mountain canyon with a near perfect reflection on its calm surface.
photo.permissionNote: Reviewed the official NPS page and its NPS photographer credit; no third-party restriction is displayed. Retain attribution and source; no endorsement is implied. Original sharpness reviewed without upscaling.
